Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating public access to information about foster parents.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public access to information about fosterparents; and adding a new section to chapter 74.13 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.13 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department must maintain for public review upon request thefollowing information regarding licensed foster parents and fosterparents who wish to adopt: (a) General residence area listed by region and local jurisdiction; (b) Any record of misdemeanor or felony convictions; (c) Current employment and employment history with salary range; (d) Educational attainment; (e) Marital or domestic partnership history to include number ofunions and current status; (f) Number of adults living in the foster home and relationship tothe foster parent; (g) Number and ages of children living in the home at the time ofplacement, to be updated every six months; p. 1 SB 5653 (h) The race or cultural background of the foster child or childrenas compared with the foster parents or foster parents who wish to adoptand any other person or persons residing in the home. (2) The information must be displayed individually based upon casenumber. (3) The department shall also include the amount of federal andstate money spent on each child, including medical care costs, duringthe child's outofhome placement. (4) The information must not include the names of the foster childor of the foster parents or foster parents who wish to adopt. (5) The department must update this information on a semiannualbasis.
